name: Pinball
description: Flippers, bumpers and multiball, right in the browser.

name: Chess
description: Play the computer at your level, get hints from a coach, or play a friend online with a room code.

name: Zero Sum
description: Dial in to an old green-screen computer and get through a standoff without anyone launching.

name: Infinite Recursion
description: A fixed shooter where the swarm learns your habits while you learn its.

name: Flappy-style flyer
description: Tap to flap through the gaps. One more try.

name: Battleship
description: Hide your fleet and call your shots.

name: Payoff
description: Bite-size game theory lessons, with tiny games against bots.

name: Drops
description: Drop discs and get four in a row. Play the computer, or a friend online with a room code.

name: Cards
description: Heads-up poker against the computer or a friend, with an odds helper that teaches the math. Play money only, for 13 and up.

name: Hot Potato
description: Swipe to slice the potatoes, and keep the hot potato in the air.
